about_the_game:
Story

Scotland, 2020. Alice is a young woman struggling through a painful breakup. Hoping to distract herself with online shopping, she buys a vintage mirror — and then whispers begin to echo through her apartment. Soon, she discovers that a mysterious figure is trapped inside the mirror, and only she can help them break free by forming a deeper connection.

Black nails and lipstick. Theatrical charm wrapped in sweet words.

Who is this creature that watches through the mirror? A ghost? A demon? Something far more dangerous? And what intentions do they hide behind that smile?

Your choices will shape Alice’s personality, how she copes with her trauma, and the nature of her relationship with the enigmatic entity known as Dinah. Are they a romantic salvation… or a dangerous escape from reality?

Is this true love, manipulation, or something far stranger?
And most importantly — who is Dinah, really?

Features

  • Approx. 1–2 hours of reading.

  • Interactive choices that shape the ending.

  • A unique artistic style blending traditional digital illustration with pixel art.

  • A flamboyant, obsessive manipulator as your romantic interest.

  • An original atmospheric soundtrack.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains depictions of scars and a small amount of blood. The game includes adult themes, sexual undertones and situation involving unclear or pressured consent, but does not contains any images of violence or nudity. Strong language is used from time to time throughout the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 (3.10 GHz) / AMD FX-4100 (3.6 GHz)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 / AMD Radeon HD 7570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game is optimized for 16:9 screens.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 (3.20 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space

short_description: Saccharine Echo is a story that walks the line between psychological drama and dark paranormal romance. Your choices will shape the fate of a young woman haunted by an obsessive entity from another world.
